name: Mara River Camp
summary: A river camp on a quiet bend of the Mara River, at the foot of the Oloololo Escarpment.
story: The day begins on foot, with the river still in mist. Elephants, giraffes and monkeys pass through the camp itself, and from July to October the Great Migration gathers at crossing points close by. Maasai guides from the camp read the grass, the tracks and the birds, and share them at walking pace. Evenings end by the open fire, as the stars come out over the river.
leads: Maasai guides, game drivers and the camp hosts
hero_alt: The Mara River curving between grassland and trees, seen from above

expect.label: Setting
expect.value: A bend of the Mara River at the foot of the Oloololo Escarpment, in the Maasai Mara, Kenya.

expect.label: Season
expect.value: Open all year. The Great Migration reaches the river from July to October.

expect.label: Stay
expect.value: River tents and bush tents with private terraces, and a two-bedroom log cabin with a deck over the river.

expect.label: At the table
expect.value: Breakfast, lunch and dinner in the garden or on the deck, the Zebra Bar until bedtime and a fire every night.

expect.label: In camp
expect.value: Swimming pool and deck, Wi-Fi throughout, a gift shop, laundry and a medical service.

expect.label: Getting there
expect.value: About 15 minutes by road from Kichwa Tembo Airstrip, with transfers from Kichwa Tembo or Musiara.
